name: rag-benchmark-dashboard
description: Private RAG benchmark dashboard (React + Vite + Node backend)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix frontend run test:unit && npm --prefix backend run test:unit
